title: customadvancements
description: Adds custom late game advancements. Play for a challenge. And if you think you are strong enough.
body: This mod adds 3 custom advancements for Minecraft. There will be more than 3 later as it updates. Currently on version 1.0.0, The first version. Next version scheduled for 5/12/2025. Will have quicker updates later though. Available as a data pack. Are you strong enough to complete these new advancements through memorable adventures?
